description: Reproducible stylized hero pipeline: Blender 5.2.3 generator, 23-joint rig with cape, 3 actions, Smile morph, 512² base/normal/roughness maps, LOD1/LOD2, GLB/FBX, non-Blender validator, and Godot runtime LOD/facial/cape systems. Prototype art, not production-final.
checks: GLB and FBX re-import in Blender with 20 bones and 3 actions
skin weights normalized, no unweighted vertices, max 3 influences
height 1.905 m, feet at ground, 4 materials, embedded 256x256 atlas
Godot demo retains GYPSY_DEMO_OK and shows the hero in capture
runtime LOD switches by camera distance and forced mode
Smile morph is driven by crystal collection
notes: Prototype limitations: no facial rig, cloth simulation, cape bones, LODs or normal maps; gameplay camera is distant.
FBX bytes are not deterministic; GLB and atlas are reproducible.
Evidence: artifacts/hero/generation-report.json, validation.json, hero-preview-contact.png; game frame.
Runtime systems are in game/scripts/hero_visual.gd and hero_integration_check.gd.
